verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp, using streamable HTTP and OAuth sign-in with no API keys. It also documents MCP tool-safety behavior, ships an official Claude Code plugin that connects the Poly MCP server, and has a first-party polymcp GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably over the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP clients can connect to `https://mcp.poly.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP). Authentication is OAuth: a browser window signs you into Poly on first connection.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets compatible AI assistants connect to Poly.
The official plugin loads your Poly memory when each session starts, teaches Claude how to use Poly, and connects the Poly MCP server.
Irreversible actions are blocked over MCP: rm archives files (reversible), and permanently deleting from the Archive is reserved for you
